sections.heading: Why Choose It?
sections.text:
Adjustable Rakhi Design: Made to offer a comfortable fit and easy wear during Raksha Bandhan rituals.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 Festive Charm Styling: Designed with decorative charm detailing to add a beautiful and meaningful festive look.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 Premium Golden Accents: Golden finishing adds a traditional, elegant, and celebration-ready touch.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 Comfortable Thread Base: Soft thread design makes it easy to tie and comfortable on the wrist.

sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
• Tie the Rakhi gently around your brother’s wrist during the Raksha Bandhan ritual.
• Adjust the thread comfortably so it sits well on the wrist without feeling too tight.
• Use it during Rakhi pooja, tilak, aarti, sweets ceremony, gifting, and festive celebrations.
• After the festival, it can be kept safely as a memory or worn as a meaningful festive accessory.
• Avoid water, perfume, sweat, and rough handling to maintain its shine and finish.
• Store separately in a dry pouch or box after use.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Minimal designs have their own charm — simple, elegant, and full of meaning. Celebrate Raksha Bandhan with this handmade Minimal Blue Rakhi, crafted with a vibrant blue adjustable thread and a sleek golden chain detail for a clean festive look.

The blue thread represents calmness, positivity, trust, and protection, while the golden chain adds a premium jewellery-inspired touch. Its minimal design makes it perfect for brothers who like subtle, stylish, and comfortable Rakhis without too many charms or heavy detailing.

Designed with an adjustable slider bead, this Rakhi fits comfortably on the wrist and can be worn during Rakhi pooja, tilak, aarti, sweets ceremony, and festive celebrations.

A Rakhi made not just for the festival, but for love, blessings, simplicity, and a bond that stays strong forever.

 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. Is this Rakhi adjustable?

Yes, it is designed to offer a comfortable fit for different wrist sizes.

Q2. Can it be worn after Raksha Bandhan?

Yes, it can be worn as a stylish and meaningful festive accessory.

Q3. Is this Rakhi good for gifting?

Yes, it is a thoughtful Raksha Bandhan gift for brothers who like stylish and meaningful designs.

Q4. Is it handmade?

Yes, each Rakhi is carefully finished, so slight variations in colour, charm placement, and finish may occur.

Q5. How should I care for it?

Avoid water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals. Store it safely in a dry place after use.

Q6. Can it be used for Rakhi pooja?

Yes, it is suitable for Rakhi pooja, tilak, aarti, sweets ceremony, and festive rituals.
